response.rationale: The anterior mediastinal mass with P40 positivity and TTF-1 negativity strongly supports squamous differentiation, most consistent with thymic squamous cell carcinoma. Pulmonary embolism is a complication of malignancy. The absence of smoking history and weight loss favors thymic origin over lung primary. Acute kidney injury may be related to contrast or paraneoplastic effects. Differential includes lung squamous cell carcinoma (less likely given no smoking and mass location) and metastatic disease (no primary identified). Thymoma and lymphoma are less likely due to P40 positivity.
